name: computer_use
description: GUI-level computer control: mouse, keyboard, screenshot, screen analysis, and app launch. Actions: screenshot, analyze_screen, mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_double_click, mouse_drag, mouse_scroll, keyboard_type, keyboard_press, keyboard_hotkey, app_launch.

action.description: One of: screenshot, analyze_screen, mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_double_click, mouse_drag, mouse_scroll, keyboard_type, keyboard_press, keyboard_hotkey, app_launch

key.description: Key to press: enter, tab, escape, f5, etc. (for keyboard_press)

name.description: App name or path to launch (for app_launch)

prompt.description: What to ask the vision model (for analyze_screen). e.g. 'What are the pixel coordinates of the Save button?'

region.description: Crop region 'x,y,w,h' for analyze_screen to zoom in on a sub-area
